annotations.text:
Marrow — desktop screens

Near-monochrome, 28px rows, 13px base. Colour carries only state and match reason.
SF Pro / SF Mono, borders not shadows, 6px radii.

Flip light/dark with the Theme chip above each artboard.
Every derived fact shows its extraction method, and absent metadata renders as an em dash rather than blank. You can always tell parsed from inferred from missing.
Degraded state is loud and always carries its fix. A watcher that quietly stopped working produces an index that is quietly wrong — worse than one that is loudly broken.
Zero results is a diagnosis, not a shrug. It names what is NOT indexed and offers the fix as a button — the state that caused the problem is the state that can fix it.
